name: rolling-text
title: Rolling Text
description: Slot-machine style text reveal where each character spins up a vertical reel of itself before landing.

props.name: text
props.description: The word rendered by the reel.

props.name: minCycles
props.description: Minimum whole letter-heights a character travels before landing.

props.name: cycleVariance
props.description: Extra random cycles added on top of minCycles.

props.name: durationVariance
props.description: Extra random duration added per character, in seconds.
